svg.title: Figure 4-1. Start-up and engagement sequence (WP-S-03 §4.1)
svg.desc: Sequence of start-up and engagement across the driver, the PCM and vehicle CAN, the E-05 relay, the E-03 safety MCU, pandad, card, controlsd and selfdrived. After ignition on the MCU boots in SILENT. pandad checks or flashes the firmware signature, sets NOOUTPUT if the MCU is SILENT and ELM327 when onroad for the firmware query. card fingerprints the car and publishes CarParams; pandad sets TOYOTA with parameter 73 via 0xdc; set_safety_hooks starts with authority false and the relay is driven. TSR-515 start-up tests are still to be inserted before the first relay drive; TSR-512 (only TOYOTA/73, then only de-escalation) is implemented in the reference build. selfdrived waits for all checks or 6 s and checks the panda mode after 10 s. When the driver presses SET the PCM raises CRUISE_ACTIVE on 0x1D2; on the rising edge, and under TSR-306 only if all RX checks are valid, the MCU sets controls_allowed. card reports cruise enabled, selfdrived goes to preEnabled/enabled, pandad sends the 0xf3 heartbeat with engaged=1 at 10 Hz, controlsd commands flow through card and sendcan, and each 0x2E4/0x343 passes safety_tx_hook limits before FDCAN TX.
svg.text: Sequence from ignition on to engaged actuation · pills on the MCU and selfdrived lifelines are states; [brackets] are transition conditions
wait: all checks or 6 s · mode/param check after 10 s
Ignition on: the device powers up
tests before the first relay drive
pandad: if the MCU is SILENT,
only if all RX checks valid
